```{r setup, include=FALSE}
source(here::here("R/report_setup.R"))
setup_report(
  sources = c("02", "03"),
  funs = c("snapshot_utils", "report_format"),
  packages = c("here", "knitr", "kableExtra", "dplyr", "ggplot2", "scales"),
  set_theme = FALSE
)

snapshots_dir <- snapshot_path()
snapshot_files <- if (dir.exists(snapshots_dir)) {
  list.files(snapshots_dir, pattern = "^snapshot_.*\\.rds$", full.names = FALSE)
} else {
  character()
}

snapshot_info <- if (length(snapshot_files) > 0) {
  do.call(rbind, lapply(snapshot_files, parse_snapshot_filename)) %>%
    mutate(mtime = file.info(file.path(snapshots_dir, filename))$mtime) %>%
    arrange(issue, mtime)
} else {
  data.frame()
}

# ---- Assemble bug-fix impact comparisons ----------------------------------
# Resolve the snapshot file for a given issue + status (newest if duplicated).
snapshot_file_for <- function(issue, status) {
  if (nrow(snapshot_info) == 0) return(NA_character_)
  hit <- snapshot_info$type == "snapshot" &
    snapshot_info$issue == issue &
    !is.na(snapshot_info$status) & snapshot_info$status == status
  if (!any(hit)) return(NA_character_)
  cand <- snapshot_info[hit, ]
  cand$filename[which.max(cand$mtime)]
}

# Build one comparison, loading both snapshots; NULL if either is unavailable.
make_comparison <- function(label, before_issue, before_status,
                            after_issue, after_status) {
  bf <- snapshot_file_for(before_issue, before_status)
  af <- snapshot_file_for(after_issue, after_status)
  if (is.na(bf) || is.na(af)) return(NULL)
  before <- tryCatch(load_snapshot(bf, snapshots_dir), error = function(e) NULL)
  after  <- tryCatch(load_snapshot(af, snapshots_dir), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(before) || is.null(after)) return(NULL)
  list(label = label, before_file = bf, after_file = af,
       before = before, after = after)
}

# Issues that have BOTH a baseline and a fixed snapshot, in numeric order.
paired_issues <- character()
if (nrow(snapshot_info) > 0) {
  snap_only <- snapshot_info[snapshot_info$type == "snapshot", ]
  issue_status <- split(snap_only$status, snap_only$issue)
  paired_issues <- names(Filter(
    function(s) all(c("baseline", "fixed") %in% s), issue_status))
  paired_issues <- paired_issues[order(as.numeric(paired_issues))]
}

comparisons <- list()
# Per-issue baseline -> fixed, one comparison per bug-fix issue.
for (iss in paired_issues) {
  comparisons[[length(comparisons) + 1]] <- make_comparison(
    paste0(if (iss == "173") "Batch #173 / #171 / #163" else paste0("Issue ", iss),
           ": baseline vs fixed"),
    iss, "baseline", iss, "fixed")
}
# Cumulative: earliest baseline -> latest fixed (only when >1 paired issue).
if (length(paired_issues) > 1) {
  # Issue numbers do not encode implementation order (#159 follows #166).
  # Use saved timestamps, which also survive checkout/copying of the files.
  snapshot_time <- function(issue, status) {
    snap <- load_snapshot(snapshot_file_for(issue, status), snapshots_dir)
    as.numeric(as.POSIXct(snap$metadata$timestamp))
  }
  first_iss <- paired_issues[which.min(vapply(paired_issues, snapshot_time,
                                            numeric(1), status = "baseline"))]
  last_iss <- paired_issues[which.max(vapply(paired_issues, snapshot_time,
                                           numeric(1), status = "fixed"))]
  comparisons[[length(comparisons) + 1]] <- make_comparison(
    paste0("Cumulative: issue ", first_iss, " baseline vs issue ",
           last_iss, " fixed"),
    first_iss, "baseline", last_iss, "fixed")
}
comparisons <- Filter(Negate(is.null), comparisons)

# ---- Impact-table builders (shared by every comparison) -------------------
build_base_impact <- function(before, after) {
  before$base_results %>%
    select(Strategy, Cost_Before = Cost, Effect_Before = Effect) %>%
    inner_join(
      after$base_results %>%
        select(Strategy, Cost_After = Cost, Effect_After = Effect),
      by = "Strategy"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      Cost_Change = Cost_After - Cost_Before,
      Effect_Change = Effect_After - Effect_Before,
      Strategy = strategy_label(Strategy),
      across(c(Cost_Before, Cost_After, Cost_Change), format_eur),
      across(c(Effect_Before, Effect_After, Effect_Change), ~ sprintf("%.4f", .x))
    )
}

build_nmb_impact <- function(before, after) {
  inner_join(
    before$nmb_at_wtp %>% select(Strategy, NMB_Before = NMB),
    after$nmb_at_wtp %>% select(Strategy, NMB_After = NMB),
    by = "Strategy"
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      NMB_Change = NMB_After - NMB_Before,
      Strategy = strategy_label(Strategy),
      across(c(NMB_Before, NMB_After, NMB_Change), format_eur)
    )
}

# EVPPI comparison (issue #152 onwards). Snapshots carry the EVPPI cache under
# `evppi`; older snapshots lack it and the table is skipped.
build_evppi_impact <- function(before, after) {
  b <- before$evppi$evppi_results
  a <- after$evppi$evppi_results
  if (is.null(b) || is.null(a) || nrow(b) == 0 || nrow(a) == 0) return(NULL)
  pick_se <- function(df) if ("evppi_se" %in% names(df)) df$evppi_se else NA_real_
  full_join(
    data.frame(Parameter = b$parameter, EVPPI_Before = b$evppi,
               Pct_Before = b$evppi_percent_of_evpi, stringsAsFactors = FALSE),
    data.frame(Parameter = a$parameter, EVPPI_After = a$evppi,
               SE_After = pick_se(a), Pct_After = a$evppi_percent_of_evpi,
               stringsAsFactors = FALSE),
    by = "Parameter"
  ) %>%
    arrange(desc(EVPPI_Before), Parameter) %>%
    mutate(
      Parameter = ifelse(grepl("^\\[GROUP\\] ", Parameter),
                         paste0(evppi_group_label(Parameter), " (group)"), Parameter),
      across(c(EVPPI_Before, EVPPI_After, SE_After), ~ format_eur(.x, accuracy = 0.01)),
      across(c(Pct_Before, Pct_After),
             ~ ifelse(is.finite(.x), sprintf("%.1f%%", .x), "--"))
    ) %>%
    select(Parameter, EVPPI_Before, Pct_Before, EVPPI_After, SE_After, Pct_After)
}

evpi_line <- function(before, after) {
  b <- before$evppi$evpi
  a <- after$evppi$evpi
  if (is.null(b) || is.null(a)) return(NULL)
  sprintf("Per-patient EVPI: %s before, %s after.",
          format_eur(b, accuracy = 0.01), format_eur(a, accuracy = 0.01))
}

# Wide table needs a smaller font in PDF (scale_down is dropped by Quarto's
# raw-table handling); tbl_style() is a no-op under gfm.
style_wide   <- function(k) tbl_style(k, latex_options = "HOLD_position", font_size = 8)
style_narrow <- function(k) tbl_style(k, latex_options = "HOLD_position")

```

Issue #181 changes PFS ascertainment for deaths without recorded progression: deaths more than 16 weeks after the last assessment are censored at that assessment (primary proxy: `TTPwk`). Recorded progression times and OS are unchanged. The clinical report compares the former all-deaths rule and the alternative `LastEvalwk` anchor. The baseline/fixed snapshots below capture the resulting economic changes after refitting and regenerating every downstream cache.

# Impact Comparisons

The issue #173 snapshot pair covers the combined fixes for **#173, #171 and
#163**. Diagnostic prices now use the scalar inputs on every call; invalid PSA
outcomes enter the failure threshold and replacement process, and supplied
curves have an explicit evaluation mode. QALYs and ongoing progressed-state
costs now use trapezoidal interval integration, while scheduled and event costs
retain their full time-point charges. These changes require new economic
results but leave the survival coefficient draws unchanged. The baseline was
saved before editing the calculation sources; both snapshots precede the
batch commit, so their filenames carry the same pre-fix HEAD identifier.

```{r overview}
if (length(comparisons) == 0) {
  cat("No baseline/fixed snapshot pairs were available for comparison.")
} else {
  overview <- do.call(rbind, lapply(comparisons, function(cmp) data.frame(
    Comparison = cmp$label,
    Before = cmp$before_file,
    After = cmp$after_file,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )))

  knitr::kable(
    overview,
    booktabs = TRUE,
    align = "l",
    caption = "Impact comparisons included in this report"
  ) %>%
    style_wide()
}
```

Each comparison below reports the change in base case costs and QALYs, and in net monetary benefit at the willingness-to-pay threshold, from the *before* snapshot to the *after* snapshot. Where both snapshots carry the EVPPI cache (snapshots taken from issue #152 onwards), the per-patient EVPI and the EVPPI table are compared as well; the *after* column includes the Monte Carlo standard error of the regression estimator. From issue #156 onwards each snapshot records the md5 and modification time of the PSA cache it copied, and a *fixed* snapshot regenerates the PSA and EVPPI caches when they predate the fix commit; the provenance line under each comparison states whether the two PSA files are the same cache.

```{r comparisons, results='asis'}
for (cmp in comparisons) {
  cat("\n\n## ", cmp$label, "\n\n")

  base_tbl <- knitr::kable(
    build_base_impact(cmp$before, cmp$after),
    booktabs = TRUE,
    align = c("l", "r", "r", "r", "r", "r", "r"),
    col.names = c("Strategy", "Cost Before", "QALYs Before",
                  "Cost After", "QALYs After", "Cost Change", "QALY Change"),
    caption = paste0("Base case impact -- ", cmp$label)
  ) %>%
    style_wide()
  cat(as.character(base_tbl), "\n\n", sep = "\n")

  nmb_tbl <- knitr::kable(
    build_nmb_impact(cmp$before, cmp$after),
    booktabs = TRUE,
    align = c("l", "r", "r", "r"),
    col.names = c("Strategy", "NMB Before", "NMB After", "NMB Change"),
    caption = paste0("Net monetary benefit impact -- ", cmp$label)
  ) %>%
    style_narrow()
  cat(as.character(nmb_tbl), "\n\n", sep = "\n")

  # PSA provenance (issue #156): identical md5 means the PSA side of the
  # comparison is a copy of the same cache, not evidence of "no change".
  cat(describe_psa_provenance(cmp$before, cmp$after), "\n\n")

  # EVPI is reported whenever both snapshots carry it, even when one EVPPI
  # table is empty (EVPI = 0 stores no rows; issue #156).
  evpi_text <- evpi_line(cmp$before, cmp$after)
  if (!is.null(evpi_text)) cat(evpi_text, "\n\n")
  evppi_df <- build_evppi_impact(cmp$before, cmp$after)
  if (!is.null(evppi_df)) {
    evppi_tbl <- knitr::kable(
      evppi_df,
      booktabs = TRUE,
      align = c("l", "r", "r", "r", "r", "r"),
      col.names = c("Parameter / group", "EVPPI Before", "% EVPI Before",
                    "EVPPI After", "SE After", "% EVPI After"),
      caption = paste0("EVPPI impact -- ", cmp$label)
    ) %>%
      style_wide()
    cat(as.character(evppi_tbl), "\n\n", sep = "\n")
  }
}
```

# Interpretation

This report compares baseline and fixed single-model snapshots for each bug-fix issue that has both, plus a cumulative comparison from the earliest baseline to the latest fixed snapshot. Snapshots are produced by the `13_save_snapshot.R` analysis script (in `analysis/`). If older snapshots contain obsolete multi-model components, `load_snapshot()` warns during render and the tables use the top-level single-model results.

Issue #166 aligns every economic strategy to the same 68-patient complete-case target. Prevalence uncertainty now samples joint biomarker cell masses and reweights control and guided strategies together. Both snapshots precede the requested fix commit and therefore carry HEAD `96d0710`; their distinct PSA fingerprints and result hashes identify the original and repaired calculations. Sampling, PSA, EVPPI and scenario caches were regenerated for the fix. The identical-treatment population tests and all 296 report/cache contracts pass; the existing PSA-versus-base-case numerical alignment criterion remains a failure, documented in `AGENTS.md`.

Issue #159 implements the first proposed fix: paired patient bootstrap fits estimate OS/PFS coefficient dependence for joint normal draws, retaining both fitted marginal covariance matrices. The deterministic results are unchanged. Crossings fell from 2,422/5,000 draws (48.44%) to 1,198/5,000 (23.96%), and EVPI at EUR 51,000 fell from EUR 0.22 to zero. The CRP incremental PSA mean changed from 0.00175 to 0.00628 QALYs, versus a deterministic increment of 0.02054. Removing all uncertainty reproduces every deterministic result, but the original five-SE numerical alignment criterion still fails for four of six level comparisons. No draws were recentered and no threshold was relaxed; nonlinear outcome averaging remains distinct from evaluation at fitted coefficients. See [the joint sampling specification](joint_survival_sampling.md).

The #159 baseline and fixed snapshots both precede the requested commit and carry HEAD `6ca19ab`, with distinct PSA fingerprints and result hashes. All active generated caches were cleared and rebuilt, and reports and publication outputs were rendered before the fixed snapshot. The cumulative comparison uses saved snapshot timestamps, because #159 was implemented after #166.


Issue #168 repairs publication artifacts and their provenance. Table S7 and Figure 5 now retain the base case with EVPI zero, distinguish failed estimates from zeros, and use scenario PSA objects to establish scenario totals. All 26 publication vignettes were rendered, all 17 tracked CSVs were checked against their generating objects, and the 37 vignette-owned artifacts are recorded in `outputs/manifest.csv`. Table 5 already agreed with the current PSA at published precision; its new regression checks guard against future drift.

The #168 baseline and fixed snapshots were saved with the usual `baseline` and `fixed` arguments before the fix commit, so both carry HEAD `b8e1b02`. The fixed snapshot regenerated all 5,000 PSA draws and EVPPI because the previous cache predated HEAD. Deterministic costs and QALYs are identical; maximum absolute PSA differences are EUR 2.91e-11 and 8.88e-16 QALYs, and EVPI remains zero. Scenario compilation was rebuilt from validated existing scenario results after verifying that the estimation functions and inputs were unchanged. The existing five-SE diagnostic still fails for four of six level comparisons; its criterion is unchanged. See [the validation record](../../../docs/validation/issue168_2026-09-22/README.md).

Issue #197 adds discounted and undiscounted life-years as a third PSA outcome, stored per draw next to cost and QALYs, and as two columns of the deterministic results. It changes no calculation of costs or QALYs: the #197 comparison above shows no change in costs, QALYs, net monetary benefit or EVPI, because the PSA was regenerated from the same sampling cache, seed and parameter draws and only the new columns were added. The exact comparison of all draws, model indices and the scenario caches is in [the validation record](../../../docs/validation/issue197_2026-10-09/README.md).

```{r issue212-population}
# Issue #212 changes only the eligible population that scales EVPI and EVPPI
# to the Norwegian population; per-patient values are compared above. The
# population scaling is read from the two snapshots' EVPPI tables.
pop212 <- local({
  bf <- snapshot_file_for("212", "baseline")
  af <- snapshot_file_for("212", "fixed")
  if (is.na(bf) || is.na(af)) return(NULL)
  b <- load_snapshot(bf, snapshots_dir)$evppi
  a <- load_snapshot(af, snapshots_dir)$evppi
  if (is.null(b$evppi_results) || is.null(a$evppi_results) ||
      !nrow(b$evppi_results) || !nrow(a$evppi_results)) return(NULL)
  annuity <- sum(1 / (1 + discount_rate_research)^seq_len(research_horizon_years))
  pop_b <- b$evppi_results$evpi_population_millions[1]
  pop_a <- a$evppi_results$evpi_population_millions[1]
  list(evpi_b = b$evpi, evpi_a = a$evpi, pop_b = pop_b, pop_a = pop_a,
       n_b = pop_b * 1e6 / (b$evpi * annuity), n_a = pop_a * 1e6 / (a$evpi * annuity))
})
```

`r if (is.null(pop212)) "" else sprintf("Issue #212 sets the share of metastatic MSS patients fit for first-line doublet chemotherapy to the co-authors' 0.60 (personal communication), so the Norwegian eligible population implied by the two snapshots' population values moves from %s to %s patients per year. Per-patient EVPI is %s before and %s after (the #212 comparison above). The population EVPI over the %d-year research horizon moves from EUR %.2f million to EUR %.2f million, a ratio of %.4f; every population EVPPI scales by the same factor.", format(round(pop212$n_b), big.mark = ","), format(round(pop212$n_a), big.mark = ","), format_eur(pop212$evpi_b, accuracy = 0.01), format_eur(pop212$evpi_a, accuracy = 0.01), research_horizon_years, pop212$pop_b, pop212$pop_a, pop212$pop_a / pop212$pop_b)`

```{r issue207-costs-only}
# Issue #207 changes resource use only (monitoring schedule and outpatient
# contacts), so costs move and QALYs and life-years must not. The check is
# made on the deterministic results and on every PSA draw of the two snapshots.
cmp207 <- local({
  bf <- snapshot_file_for("207", "baseline")
  af <- snapshot_file_for("207", "fixed")
  if (is.na(bf) || is.na(af)) return(NULL)
  b <- load_snapshot(bf, snapshots_dir)
  a <- load_snapshot(af, snapshots_dir)
  pb <- find_snapshot_pair(bf, snapshots_dir)
  pa <- find_snapshot_pair(af, snapshots_dir)
  if (is.null(pb) || is.null(pa)) return(NULL)
  psa_b <- load_snapshot(pb$psa, snapshots_dir)
  psa_a <- load_snapshot(pa$psa, snapshots_dir)
  v_strategies <- get_strategies()
  max_diff <- function(x, y) max(abs(as.matrix(x[, v_strategies]) - as.matrix(y[, v_strategies])))
  det_b <- b$base_results[match(v_strategies, b$base_results$Strategy), ]
  det_a <- a$base_results[match(v_strategies, a$base_results$Strategy), ]
  list(
    strategies = v_strategies,
    det_cost_b = det_b$Cost, det_cost_a = det_a$Cost,
    psa_cost_b = colMeans(psa_b$cost[, v_strategies]),
    psa_cost_a = colMeans(psa_a$cost[, v_strategies]),
    det_effect = max(abs(det_b$Effect - det_a$Effect)),
    det_ly = max(abs(c(det_b$LY_disc - det_a$LY_disc, det_b$LY_undisc - det_a$LY_undisc))),
    psa_effect = max_diff(psa_b$effectiveness, psa_a$effectiveness),
    psa_ly = max(max_diff(psa_b$ly_disc, psa_a$ly_disc), max_diff(psa_b$ly_undisc, psa_a$ly_undisc)),
    same_model_idx = identical(psa_b$model_idx, psa_a$model_idx),
    n_sim = psa_a$n_sim, evpi_b = b$evppi$evpi, evpi_a = a$evppi$evpi
  )
})
#' "Label EUR before to EUR after" for every strategy, comma-separated.
cost_list207 <- function(before, after) {
  paste(sprintf("%s %s to %s", strategy_labels[cmp207$strategies],
                format_eur(before, accuracy = 1), format_eur(after, accuracy = 1)),
        collapse = ", ")
}
```

`r if (is.null(cmp207)) "" else sprintf("Issue #207 replaces the monitoring and contact schedule with the trial team's answers of 15 October 2026: a CT every 8 weeks while progression-free (was 12), a blood test in every administration week and, off treatment, with every CT (was every 4 weeks), two outpatient contacts per FLOX administration, and a follow-up visit and CT every 2.5 months after progression (was quarterly). Only costs move. Deterministic costs: %s. PSA mean costs: %s. The QALYs are unchanged (maximum absolute difference %s deterministic and %s over all %s PSA draws), and so are the discounted and undiscounted life-years (%s and %s), with %s model indices. Per-patient EVPI at the base WTP moves from %s to %s.", cost_list207(cmp207$det_cost_b, cmp207$det_cost_a), cost_list207(cmp207$psa_cost_b, cmp207$psa_cost_a), format(signif(cmp207$det_effect, 2)), format(signif(cmp207$psa_effect, 2)), format(cmp207$n_sim, big.mark = ","), format(signif(cmp207$det_ly, 2)), format(signif(cmp207$psa_ly, 2)), if (cmp207$same_model_idx) "identical" else "different", format_eur(cmp207$evpi_b, accuracy = 0.01), format_eur(cmp207$evpi_a, accuracy = 0.01))`

```{r issue208-later-sequences}
# Issue #208 adds the third and fourth treatment sequences as expected costs per
# patient assigned to an arm, whatever the health state, so costs move and
# QALYs and life-years must not. The four later-sequence shares are new PSA
# parameters sampled after every other parameter, so the other parameter draws
# are unchanged. Checked on the deterministic results, every PSA draw and every
# cell of the PSA cell component.
cmp208 <- local({
  bf <- snapshot_file_for("208", "baseline")
  af <- snapshot_file_for("208", "fixed")
  if (is.na(bf) || is.na(af)) return(NULL)
  b <- load_snapshot(bf, snapshots_dir)
  a <- load_snapshot(af, snapshots_dir)
  pb <- find_snapshot_pair(bf, snapshots_dir)
  pa <- find_snapshot_pair(af, snapshots_dir)
  if (is.null(pb) || is.null(pa)) return(NULL)
  psa_b <- load_snapshot(pb$psa, snapshots_dir)
  psa_a <- load_snapshot(pa$psa, snapshots_dir)
  v_strategies <- get_strategies()
  max_diff <- function(x, y) max(abs(as.matrix(x[, v_strategies]) - as.matrix(y[, v_strategies])))
  det_b <- b$base_results[match(v_strategies, b$base_results$Strategy), ]
  det_a <- a$base_results[match(v_strategies, a$base_results$Strategy), ]
  v_health <- c("qalys", "ly_disc", "ly_undisc")
  group_row <- function(e, name) {
    if (is.null(e$evppi_results)) return(NULL)
    e$evppi_results[e$evppi_results$parameter == name, , drop = FALSE]
  }
  later_group <- group_row(a$evppi, "[GROUP] later_sequences")
  list(
    strategies = v_strategies,
    det_cost_b = det_b$Cost, det_cost_a = det_a$Cost,
    psa_cost_b = colMeans(psa_b$cost[, v_strategies]),
    psa_cost_a = colMeans(psa_a$cost[, v_strategies]),
    det_effect = max(abs(det_b$Effect - det_a$Effect)),
    det_ly = max(abs(c(det_b$LY_disc - det_a$LY_disc, det_b$LY_undisc - det_a$LY_undisc))),
    psa_effect = max_diff(psa_b$effectiveness, psa_a$effectiveness),
    psa_ly = max(max_diff(psa_b$ly_disc, psa_a$ly_disc), max_diff(psa_b$ly_undisc, psa_a$ly_undisc)),
    same_model_idx = identical(psa_b$model_idx, psa_a$model_idx),
    same_cells = identical(psa_b$cells$values[, , , v_health], psa_a$cells$values[, , , v_health]),
    nivo_b = mean(psa_b$cells$values[, , "experimental", "nivo_admin"]),
    nivo_a = mean(psa_a$cells$values[, , "experimental", "nivo_admin"]),
    n_sim = psa_a$n_sim, evpi_b = b$evppi$evpi, evpi_a = a$evppi$evpi,
    later_evppi = if (!is.null(later_group) && nrow(later_group)) later_group$evppi[1] else NA_real_,
    later_se = if (!is.null(later_group) && nrow(later_group)) later_group$evppi_se[1] else NA_real_
  )
})
#' "Label EUR before to EUR after" for every strategy, comma-separated.
cost_list208 <- function(before, after) {
  paste(sprintf("%s %s to %s", strategy_labels[cmp208$strategies],
                format_eur(before, accuracy = 1), format_eur(after, accuracy = 1)),
        collapse = ", ")
}
```

`r if (is.null(cmp208)) "" else sprintf("Issue #208 costs the third and fourth treatment sequences from the trial's administration records: for each arm, the share of patients who started them times one full sequence of the arm's regimen at the observed start weeks, whatever the health state; omitting the second sequence omits them too. Only costs move. Deterministic costs: %s. PSA mean costs: %s. The discounted nivolumab administrations under the experimental arm (the price slope of paper 3, averaged over draws and cells) rise from %.2f to %.2f. Issue #209 is a change of base-case scope, not a bug fix: second-line therapy after progression is costed from the Norwegian pathway, once at incident progression. The #209 comparison above therefore shows costs rising in every strategy and QALYs and life-years unchanged. The incremental costs fall slightly, because the guided strategies delay progression. The PSA was regenerated from the same sampling cache and seed; the second-line parameters are drawn after all earlier parameters, so every earlier draw is unchanged.

```{r issue216-second-line-after-207-208}
# Snapshot pair 216: the #209 second-line therapy merged on top of #207
# (monitoring) and #208 (later sequences). Only costs may move: the second-line
# rows are drawn after every earlier parameter, so QALYs and life-years must be
# identical in every draw.
cmp216 <- local({
  bf <- snapshot_file_for("216", "baseline")
  af <- snapshot_file_for("216", "fixed")
  if (is.na(bf) || is.na(af)) return(NULL)
  b <- load_snapshot(bf, snapshots_dir)
  a <- load_snapshot(af, snapshots_dir)
  pb <- find_snapshot_pair(bf, snapshots_dir)
  pa <- find_snapshot_pair(af, snapshots_dir)
  if (is.null(pb) || is.null(pa)) return(NULL)
  psa_b <- load_snapshot(pb$psa, snapshots_dir)
  psa_a <- load_snapshot(pa$psa, snapshots_dir)
  v_strategies <- get_strategies()
  v_control <- v_strategies[1]
  max_diff <- function(x, y) max(abs(as.matrix(x[, v_strategies]) - as.matrix(y[, v_strategies])))
  det_b <- b$base_results[match(v_strategies, b$base_results$Strategy), ]
  det_a <- a$base_results[match(v_strategies, a$base_results$Strategy), ]
  ratio <- function(cost, effect) (cost[-1] - cost[1]) / (effect[-1] - effect[1])
  psa_mean <- function(x) colMeans(as.matrix(x[, v_strategies]))
  group_row <- function(e, name) {
    if (is.null(e$evppi_results)) return(NULL)
    e$evppi_results[e$evppi_results$parameter == name, , drop = FALSE]
  }
  sl_group <- group_row(a$evppi, "[GROUP] second_line")
  list(
    strategies = v_strategies,
    det_cost_b = det_b$Cost, det_cost_a = det_a$Cost,
    psa_cost_b = psa_mean(psa_b$cost), psa_cost_a = psa_mean(psa_a$cost),
    det_ratio_b = ratio(det_b$Cost, det_b$Effect), det_ratio_a = ratio(det_a$Cost, det_a$Effect),
    psa_ratio_b = ratio(psa_mean(psa_b$cost), psa_mean(psa_b$effectiveness)),
    psa_ratio_a = ratio(psa_mean(psa_a$cost), psa_mean(psa_a$effectiveness)),
    det_effect = max(abs(det_b$Effect - det_a$Effect)),
    det_ly = max(abs(c(det_b$LY_disc - det_a$LY_disc, det_b$LY_undisc - det_a$LY_undisc))),
    psa_effect = max_diff(psa_b$effectiveness, psa_a$effectiveness),
    psa_ly = max(max_diff(psa_b$ly_disc, psa_a$ly_disc), max_diff(psa_b$ly_undisc, psa_a$ly_undisc)),
    same_model_idx = identical(psa_b$model_idx, psa_a$model_idx),
    n_sim = psa_a$n_sim, evpi_b = b$evppi$evpi, evpi_a = a$evppi$evpi,
    sl_evppi = if (!is.null(sl_group) && nrow(sl_group)) sl_group$evppi[1] else NA_real_,
    sl_se = if (!is.null(sl_group) && nrow(sl_group)) sl_group$evppi_se[1] else NA_real_
  )
})
#' "Label EUR before to EUR after" for the given strategies, comma-separated.
cost_list216 <- function(before, after, ids = cmp216$strategies) {
  paste(sprintf("%s %s to %s", strategy_labels[ids],
                format_eur(before, accuracy = 1), format_eur(after, accuracy = 1)),
        collapse = ", ")
}
#' Same for ratios; a negative ratio (fewer QALYs at higher cost) is never
#' printed as a cost per QALY.
ratio_list216 <- function(before, after, ids = cmp216$strategies[-1]) {
  fmt <- function(x) ifelse(x < 0, "dominated by standard of care", format_eur(x, accuracy = 1))
  paste(sprintf("%s %s to %s", strategy_labels[ids], fmt(before), fmt(after)), collapse = ", ")
}
```
